title: Multi-key writer gateway V10R1 ratification candidate
summary: Finalize the compact V9/V10 writer scout by making V10's line-anchored and ASCII-only choices deliberate, making OFF multiple-ACT diagnostic-only, binding the U+00A0 negatives, and stating the complete shortcut-family claim domain.
system_thesis: The supervised conditional-writer scout is now implementation-determinate under simple local hygiene; the amendment changes no fit, benchmark geometry, resource cap, cognitive architecture, or C11 boundary.

context_files.purpose: Normative final amendment and maximum permitted wording.
Output-predicate and claim amendment incorporated below V10R1.
Adjudicated final local corrections and explicit C11 rejection.

nodes.before: V10's line-anchored metric left OFF gate status ambiguous.
nodes.after: The line-anchored byte rule is deliberate; adapter conditions alone gate at zero and OFF is diagnostic-only.
nodes.rationale: Preserve an adapter-interface estimand without letting base behavior change its label.

nodes.before: V10 selected ASCII trimming without a required discriminator from Unicode stripping.
nodes.after: ASCII-only boundary trimming is deliberate for primary and native outputs, with valid-UTF-8 U+00A0 negative fixtures.
nodes.rationale: Make the byte grammar exact and substitution-detecting.

edges.before: V10 used shorthand that could omit stratum-by-mode and covariate-by-mode families.
edges.after: The claim enumerates all five named deterministic families and every declared non-key categorical covariate alone and crossed with mode on each frozen scored multiset.
edges.rationale: Match the claim exactly to deterministic evidence rather than an inferred or fitted shortcut test.

loops.before: The incorporated V9/V10 loop had two final label/claim ambiguities.
loops.after: The unchanged compact loop applies adapter-only multiple-ACT gating, diagnostic OFF reporting, explicit ASCII divergence fixtures, and exact shortcut quantifiers.
loops.trigger: Implementation begins only after exact human V10R1 ratification; every real tokenizer/model/training/adapter/GPU action remains separately gated.
writes: three named implementation files after ratification
loops.stop_condition: Stop on any inherited or amended CPU-test/review failure; preserve all execution, claim, lineage, parenting, and C11 prohibitions.
loops.rationale: Finish the smallest valid writer scout without any experiment or guard expansion.

claims.before: V10 correctly separated per-adapter key gates but abbreviated its shortcut domain.
claims.after: A pass may use only the exact V10R1 statement, including all four adapters, per-adapter 16-key NLL gates, partial directional counts, exact deterministic shortcut/covariate domains, and spill/interface bounds.
claims.evidence_needed: Every incorporated V9/V10 gate and V10R1 fixture passes on both roots under separately authorized execution.

cells.reason: The complete OFF raw outputs are preserved.
The rate is computed and reported but excluded from every gate and label.
The renderer may report it as a diagnostic but cannot use it to qualify the pass.
The complete adapter raw outputs are preserved.
Each adapter's fixed 64 outputs gate at zero occurrences.
Only the sealed interface gate reaches result wording.
Reviewers inspect raw cases and gate computation.
The deterministic shortcut table cannot enter model requests.
The reducer requires its sealed hash and exact maxima.
It supplies only the exact enumerated deterministic wording.
Reviewers verify every family and quantifier.

acceptance_tests.setup: Verify incorporated V9, V10, and V10-consensus hashes and compute the effective layered contract.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the adjudicated local predicate, OFF diagnostic, U+00A0 fixture, and claim-quantifier choices supersede V9/V10; every other term remains unchanged.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The successor silently changes the experiment or imports C11.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run distinguishing line-anchored, inline, repeated-same-line, ASCII-boundary, U+00A0-boundary, OFF-only multiple-ACT, adapter-only multiple-ACT, and native strict-equality golden records.
acceptance_tests.expected: V10R1 byte choices reproduce exactly; OFF-only multiple ACT never changes a label; adapter-only multiple ACT yields INTERFACE_INVALID at inherited precedence; U+00A0 is not trimmed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The final interface gate still depends on implementation judgment or silently reverts to another grammar.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run every inherited MWG9/MWG10 deterministic CPU obligation and assert the exact maximum-claim family and covariate quantifiers.
acceptance_tests.expected: All geometry, visibility, metric, label, integrity, parser, inheritance, and claim-domain fixtures pass without real tokenizer, model, trainer, adapter, or GPU use.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The three-file scout is not ready for bound review.

acceptance_tests.setup: One fresh independent implementation reviewer and one separate scientific advocate inspect identical effective scope, source, tests, manifest, and dry-run hashes after scoped implementation.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both PASS before later exact execution ratification; independent rejection controls.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The scout is not ready for model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution.

human_boundary.decision_question: Approve only the exact V10R1 layered three-file source implementation and deterministic CPU-test scope while preserving every execution and claim prohibition?
forbidden_before_approval: author the three named implementation files
invoke models, tokenizers, trainers, adapters, or GPUs
make scientific claims or release artifacts
